needs_atom.missing: Each creature you control gets +3/+3 until end of turn and must be blocked this turn if able.: the '+3/+3 until end of turn' half is expressible (MODIFY_PT ALL creatures you control, DurationEot), but no component gives a lure that ENDS this turn. The IR form MANDATE_BLOCK{cards: ALL creatures you control, duration: DurationEot} is accepted, but the executor's dispatch handler (verbs._v_mandate_block) ignores the duration and adds the creatures to executor.mandate_block, which is cleared only when a creature leaves the battlefield: mapper pack shows the opponent's wall still forced to block the bear on the NEXT turn (permanent lure, stronger than printed). The granted-static alternative GRANT_ABILITY(StaticAbility(MANDATE_BLOCK self), DurationEot) is not consumed by block legality (no forced block even this turn). Needs executor support for MANDATE_BLOCK's duration role (expire the dispatched entry at end of turn).
